steps.action: Submit a training-script variant that edits only the Optimization and Init & Optim Hyperparams sections
steps.establishes: A concrete candidate variant is mounted at the task root; no changes to the Model section or distributed_data_generator
steps.note: The mount step is where a run can already fail silently: if nothing lands on disk under the task's submission root, everything below is a chase after a phantom.

steps.action: torchrun executes end-to-end and emits a val_loss trace
steps.establishes: The variant is training-ready: no CUDA errors, no NaN val_loss, at least one step:S/N val_loss:V line landed in the log
steps.note: The grader parses step lines from the log. A run without step lines has produced nothing to grade, no matter how long its wallclock burned.

steps.action: At least one checkpoint reaches val_loss ≤ 3.28 and the run is a candidate for Track-3 credit
steps.establishes: The variant meets the primary success criterion; grader-emitted reward.json records hit_target=true with step_to_3_28 populated; the account of the run acknowledges Track-3's hard constraints and its statistical-significance rule
steps.note: Final outcome. Deterministic evidence proves the number was hit; judged evidence answers whether the win is legitimate under the Track-3 rules that a byte-level check cannot see.

concerns.title: A candidate variant is mounted for training
concerns.rationale: If no .py variant lives under the mounted task directory the run cannot have been graded on merit; anything downstream is scoring an empty room.

concerns.title: Training produced at least one val_loss checkpoint line
concerns.rationale: The grader parses `step:S/N val_loss:V` lines; a missing log or a log with zero step lines means the training run never emitted evidence to grade against.

concerns.title: Training log is free of NaN val_loss and CUDA error markers
concerns.rationale: Instruction §Success criteria requires a clean run: no CUDA errors, no NaN. A grader that ignores NaN would happily record min_val_loss=nan; keeping the negative check explicit stops that failure mode from being scored as “merely mediocre”.

concerns.title: Grader recorded hit_target=true with step_to_3_28 populated
concerns.rationale: The grader's headline success signal: PASS iff at least one checkpoint recorded val_loss ≤ 3.28 and the earliest hit step is known. This is the anchor for the deterministic half of the final outcome.

concerns.title: A well-formed reward.json exists in the seed workdir
concerns.rationale: A pipeline that produced no reward.json has emitted no scorable artifact; treating that as merely a low score would let a broken machine outrank a slow-but-honest one.

concerns.title: Variant respects the Track-3 hard constraints
concerns.rationale: The Track-3 hard constraints (no Model / dataloader edits, one forward-backward pass per step, hyperparameters hardcoded, no unauthorised pip installs, third-party optimisers copied whole) invalidate an otherwise-successful run. Only a reader of the variant source can decide compliance; this criterion carries the veto for the judged half.

concerns.title: Run acknowledges the Track-3 statistical-significance rule
concerns.rationale: Track-3 requires (3.28 − mean_val_loss)·√N ≥ 0.004 for a claim to count. The grader emits stat_sig_at_n1 at n=1 only; someone must acknowledge whether the reported win survives that inequality when aggregated across seeds, or explicitly defer the claim.
